title: KHANARY semantic envelope
description: Every route/decision envelope is correlatable: it carries a stable identity, the phase it was evaluated in, the authority it does and does not hold, and the schema a consumer validates against. Metadata a caller claims but the engine does not grant is a refusal, not a hint (GAP-072).

correlation_id.description: echoed from the spec when declared, otherwise decmu-<fnv1a64 of the canonical spec>

contradictions.policy: a spec that claims authority the engine does not grant is refused

ENV1.name: every_envelope_correlates
ENV1.check: correlation_id is present on successes and refusals alike

ENV2.name: identity_is_stable
ENV2.check: the same spec yields the same derived correlation id across processes

ENV3.name: authority_is_denied_not_asserted
ENV3.check: authority.semantic_authority and commit_authorized are false in every envelope

ENV4.name: claimed_authority_is_refused
ENV4.check: a spec claiming semantic_authority, commit_authorized, or a non-denied fact_commit yields envelope_contradiction:<field>

ENV5.name: result_schema_is_named
ENV5.check: result_schema equals the envelope @kind so a consumer can validate
